description: Get the one line that embeds a Site of the day award, plus instructions for pasting it. The ribbon names the award and the period and links to the verification page. Read-only. No money. Pass site_id for a site on this account, or host for any confirmed winner. Omit both to list awards this account has earned.

host.description: Optional. The public host that was featured.

site_id.description: Optional. A site on this account (from list_sites).

name: site_of_the_day_badge
